**FENNIE\+MEHL Architects \| Senior Interior Designer, Corporate Interiors**

**Position Category:** SeniorInterior Design

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Experience Level:**

Interior Designer: 7\-10 years minimum professional work experience with a focus on Corporate Interiors

**Educational Level:**

Equivalent to graduation from an accredited four\-year college or university with major coursework in interior design or architecture

**Professional License:**

NCIDQ preferred

**We are looking for the Right Fit:**

Our growing studio is seeking agile, authentic, and collaborative professionals to join our team. Located in San Francisco’s SOMA district, we are a studio of passionate, energetic, and highly motivated individuals. Together, our team of talented architects, interior designers, and graphic designers, create powerful and unexpected, award\-winning designs. Status quo is not an option in our work.

**Studio Culture:**

At FENNIE\+MEHL we are a tight\-knit team and are looking for candidates who share our team’s values. Our studio is an open and collaborative culture that values – and really does encourage – ideas from all corners of the office. Our award\-winning designs are inspired by the diversity of who we are and what we love – art, travel, food, photography, beekeeping, you name it! Here at F\+M, we believe that life is design, 24/7\. We genuinely like each other, so our calendars have social events that build connection, including weekly happy hours and outings alongside in\-house design and technical training sessions.

**Position Overview – Interior Designer:**

The Senior Interior Designer will be responsible for handling professional design activities across a wide variety of project types and to lead staff, as well as assist senior leaders, in production, project management, client management, and related responsibilities. The position is responsible for handling a wide variety of project types and complex professional design activities, including: predesign, programming, visioning, spatial planning, materials, finishes, detailing, FF\&E, lighting specifications, and code requirements. The role includes contributing to project delivery, drawing details, modeling, rendering, construction documents, CA, and leading and supporting business development activities and firm operations.

The Interior Designer will communicate and collaborate closely with senior management and firm leadership, clients, staff, consultants, vendors and contractors. The position is a solid platform for personal career growth, and supports the studio’s overall success and growth.

Organization, creativity, and the ability to remain pragmatic with a proven foundation in design concepts and principles, practices, and construction are key factors we are looking for. Excellent written and verbal communication, collaboration, interpersonal and problem\-solving skills will lead to success in this role. As a team of passionate designers working together, we rely on our team members to be agile and flexible, humble but driven, with a client\-focused mindset. We are results\-driven and utilize our broad skillsets on multiple, fast\-paced projects every day.

**Requirements:** 

* Proficiency in Revit
* Proficiency in Enscape, renderings, CAD, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Excel, MS Office tools and Bluebeam Revu

**The Interior Designer will:**

* Contribute to producing conceptual and fully executed designs with strong creative design ideas, out\-of\-the\-box preferred!
* Have their finger on the pulse of current Furniture, Material, Finish, and Design for commercial interiors
* Manage project\-specific budget, schedule, workload, and staffing with little Principal oversight
* Create Construction Documents independently
* Have the ability to work with multiple clients, and on multiple projects, simultaneously
* Contribute to producing conceptual and fully executed designs
* Collaborate, within project teams and with vendors and consultants, to produce successful design outcomes
* Be motivated to participate in and support firm Business Development activities
* Provide mentorship and leadership support to other team members

Our studio offers competitive compensation packages. Salary commensurate with experience and includes:

* Comprehensive benefits package
* 401K plan
* Flex work schedule
* 10 paid holidays \+ Christmas\-New Years week

If you desire leadership opportunities within a design studio, we want to talk to you. F\+M offers plenty of opportunity and supports you in your growing career.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


**About the Role:**

We are seeking a creative expert to join our Performance Marketing team as Manager, Performance Creative. This role leads creative ideation and concept development that fuels Netflix's global performance marketing operation: from data\-driven ad concepts and creator partnerships to new content categories and channel\-specific creative strategy. The ideal candidate combines creative thinking with performance marketing expertise: someone who can turn audience insights and competitive research into breakthrough concepts, and partner across Brand, Social, and Production to bring them to life at scale.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead creative ideation and concept development, translating performance insights, audience data, and market trends into creative briefs ready for production.
* Collaborate with designers, writers, producers, and media buyers to turn concepts into high\-performing assets, partnering closely with the Creative Producer on production handoff.
* Partner with Growth Strategy to build and execute a forward\-looking creative testing roadmap, with clear hypotheses on hooks, value props, visual styles, messaging, and more.
* Own the creative strategy for net\-new content categories beyond single\-title assets: multi\-title, lifestyle, catalog, and licensed content.
* Build and manage Netflix's creator program for performance marketing: identify, brief, and manage creator agency relationships for scaled, performance\-centric native content across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and beyond.
* Serve as the creative lead on new and emerging channel formats (DSP, CTV, YouTube), defining the creative approach and specs as we enter new placements.
* Establish a reactive pipeline that can jump on trends and insights, and turn assets around rapidly.
* Partner with Brand to conceptualize larger performance marketing moments that sell the full value of Netflix to potential members beyond individual title campaigns.
* Stay ahead of platform trends, creative techniques, and cultural moments, turning them into fresh concepts and rapid\-response creative opportunities.

**Requirements**

* 7\+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance marketing, or growth marketing, ideally with entertainment or consumer brand experience.
* A proven track record of creative concepts that directly resulted in measurable CPA reduction or revenue growth.
* Strong understanding of ad performance metrics (CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS) and the ability to translate data into clear, actionable creative direction.
* Deep hands\-on experience across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, DSPs, and emerging digital channels.
* Experience managing creator partnerships and influencer programs for performance marketing.
* Resourceful and endlessly curious, with a high comfort level for independently driving complex creative initiatives with multiple stakeholders.
* High tolerance for change and the capacity to accomplish significant work in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment.
* Strong level of ownership, accountability, and ability to manage multiple stakeholders across different projects.
* Respect, understanding, and enthusiasm for Netflix culture.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $220,000\.00 \- $347,000\.00\.
Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here .


Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here .


Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

**Who We Are**
--------------

  

Zion HealthShare is a nonprofit medical cost\-sharing program that provides an organized structure for members to contribute toward each other’s medical costs. We offer individuals and organizations across the country an affordable alternative to insurance; this provides peace of mind. Our goal is to be America’s leading HealthShare. We strive to meet our members’ needs on a personal level by following our core values: community, simplicity, transparency, and compassion.

  

Everything we do for our members is to ensure they feel respected and to let them know we truly care about their needs. Our mission is to change the healthcare industry by connecting like\-minded individuals to an innovative and affordable medical cost\-sharing community.

 **About the role**

  

The Head of Creative leads all branding, design, and creative output for Zion HealthShare. This role owns the visual identity of the organization and is responsible for maintaining quality and consistency across all visual asset the company produces including graphic design, video, sales collateral, and digital content. The Head of Creative both sets creative direction and rolls up their sleeves to produce work, while supervising and developing a Multimedia Designer and building the creative function as it grows.

 **What you'll do**

* Lead and evolve Zion HealthShare's brand identity, ensuring a consistent visual experience across all marketing channels and customer touchpoints.
* Establish and maintain brand standards, serving as the final reviewer for creative assets and ensuring brand consistency.
* Develop compelling visual concepts and creative campaigns that support marketing initiatives and business objectives.
* Oversee the creation of digital and print materials, including graphics, video, presentations, web content, social media, email, advertising, and event collateral.
* Direct multimedia projects from concept through production, including video, photography, motion graphics, and design.
* Manage creative vendors, freelancers, and production partners to deliver high\-quality work on time and within budget.
* Supervise and mentor the Multimedia Designer, providing creative leadership, coaching, and professional development.
* Manage creative project workflows, priorities, timelines, and quality standards while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Develop and improve creative processes, asset management, and standard operating procedures to support an efficient creative function.
* Oversee branded merchandise, promotional products, and the company swag store while supporting the continued growth of the creative team.

**Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of professional creative and design experience, including time at a senior or lead level.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating range across branding, graphic design, video, and marketing collateral (required with application).
* Proven ability to lead creative projects end to end and to direct, mentor, or manage other designers.
* Expert proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects); familiarity with other common design tools.
* Hands\-on experience producing video content — from concept and filming through editing and motion graphics.
* Strong eye for typography, layout, color, and visual storytelling, with meticulous attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and project\-management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to both set creative direction and take it, and to give and receive constructive feedback.
* Comfortable working onsite in St. George, Utah, and collaborating in a fast\-paced, in\-house creative environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience or other certification will be considered.
* Committed to continuous growth through workshops, seminars, and/or industry conferences.
* Experience producing podcast or audio content is a plus, including recording, editing, and audio post\-production.

**Benefits**

* 13 paid holidays, including your birthday and personal preference day, plus up to 3 weeks of paid time off to balance work and life.
* Healthcare package including Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA with a company match, Supplemental Insurance like Life and Short\-Term Disability, Health Share and a free DPC Memberships.
* Invest in your future with a 401k plan backed by a solid 4% match from us.
* Enjoy the simplicity of bi\-weekly paychecks along with the perk of free snacks and regular lunches available onsite.
* Build strong connections with colleagues at our frequent, fun team\-building events.

  

**The pay range for this role is:**  

60,000 \- 70,000 USD per year(St George)

**About Dust**
==============

**Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.**


With enterprise\-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest\-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.


With 70%\+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. **We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.**


We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026\.


Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50\.

**TLDR**
========


As the Creative Director you will define how Dust shows up in the world, from our website and product launches to campaigns, events, video, and the visual systems that make our brand promise compelling and our product narrative credible. As an AI company, we expect our brand to be built the AI\-native way: fast, systematic, and unmistakably ours.

**What you'll own**
===================

**Brand system \& identity**
----------------------------


Set the direction for Dust's visual identity: motion, illustration, typography, video style, and brand guidelines. Make it differentiating and memorable. Keep it enterprise\-credible.

**Creative execution**
----------------------


Lead creative direction across every major output: website, product launches, campaigns, events, GTM and sales assets, social. Flex between brand and product storytelling work. Own the visual language for launch moments and make IRL brand experiences feel like a high\-integrity signal, not a booth.

**Creative operations**
-----------------------


Create the operating model for brand design at Dust: intake, prioritization, review, and standards. Build and manage the network of freelancers and agencies that lets a small team punch above its weight. Our ambition is to grow a small, world\-class creative team around this role, working closely with our Paris\-based product design team and contractor network.

**Scale creative with AI**
--------------------------


Define and own a brand system that lets the team (and AI tools) produce high\-quality, on\-brand assets at speed — codifying our visual identity into documented guidelines, templates, and reusable components so lower\-lift work (landing pages, social, blog and event graphics, slides) can be created consistently without a designer touching every execution.

**Your first 6 months**
=======================

* **First weeks:** Immerse in the brand, the product, and the team. Audit current assets and identify the highest\-leverage gaps. Start building a network of freelancers and agencies.
* **By month 3:** Lead creative direction on the updated website — the most visible expression of Dust's value proposition as we grow.
* **By month 6:** Refresh and build on brand guidelines — aligning video and motion style with core identity, covering illustration, iconography, and photographic direction.

**Who you are**
===============

* You’re a visual storyteller. You've led brand or creative work where the narrative came first and the visual system was built to serve it.
* You have exceptional taste and can defend your preferences, and you also know how to align your instincts to the direction of the brand and product.
* You're hands\-on. You make things. You can art\-direct a video, push pixels on a landing page, and give a freelancer the right brief — all in the same week.
* You're AI\-fluent. You treat AI as a core part of the creative toolkit, not a threat to craft. You're already using AI intentionally in your own design and production workflow, and you're excited to build systems that let a small team punch far above its weight. (Bonus: experience building brand or design systems, template libraries, or prompt\-driven workflows that let non\-designers self\-serve on\-brand work.)
* You've built or scaled a creative function. You've hired designers, set standards, and created the systems that let a small team punch above its weight.
* You have a point of view on the market. You understand what resonates with AI\-mature buyers and technical decision\-makers, and you can make Dust feel culturally magnetic to them.
* You can work across Paris and the US. Most of the company is still based in Paris, while the US team is growing across New York and San Francisco. You need to be proactive, clear in writing, and comfortable pushing work forward across time zones.
* You've worked at or deeply admire companies with strong brand craft — Airbnb, Webflow, Intercom, Linear, Anthropic, or their equivalent. You know what great looks like and you've shipped it.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience building or refreshing a visual identity for a fast\-growing technology company.
* Experience working with founders on brand, narrative, launch moments, or executive presence.
* A strong network of creative collaborators across motion, video, production, photography, illustration, web, and experiential work.
* Experience designing interactive web experiences, motion systems, or product\-led storytelling.
* Messaging, content strategy, or campaign strategy depth. This is a bonus, not the core requirement.

**What we offer**
=================

* A front\-row seat at one of the most interesting companies in AI right now \- early enough for real equity upside, late enough for proven PMF.
* A small, candid, low\-ego team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously.
* 5 days a week in the office (SF or NYC) with a team that genuinely wants to be together.
* Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
* Health insurance for you and your dependents
* New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc.
* The opportunity to travel to Paris multiple times a year
* Regular team events and offsite

**Location**
============


We're prioritizing building our team with an in\-person culture at our offices in Paris, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.


We have an office\-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.  

  

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

**Why Dust**
============


The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.


We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.


If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

*Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.*

Federal Signal has an immediate opening for a Sales Manager to promote our Police \& Fire market vehicle products. The territory will include the following states: Delaware, Long Island, Maryland, and New Jersey. The ideal candidate should be based in the Delaware area.



Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities


* Coordinates activities to obtain assigned new business and sales quota.
* Communicates with business unit personnel concerning the business environment, how our products rate in the marketplace, price sensitivity, product mix, technology, market trends, etc., and how to resolve procedural, sales distribution, delivery and service problems.
* Responds in a timely and effective manner to competitive and market opportunities as well as communications from distributors, dealers, OEMs, end users and the factory.
* Communicates to manufacturer reps and group staff on all pertinent matters of mutual concern.
* Develops and implements an annual sales plan.
* Coordinates participation in local, state, regional and national trade shows with non\-sales staff as required.
* Maintains quarterly market coverage documentation. Processes annual distributor agreements, documents and approves additions/ deletions to the distributor network.
* Contributes positively to the corporate bottom line through effective expense control.
* Facilitates information flow to the factory, sales reps and accounts in a timely fashion.
* Works with inside sales team to maintain all quotations within assigned territory and ensures an acceptable level of margin.
* Forecasts accurately; sales by product on a monthly basis to coordinate production schedules and ensure timely delivery of products.
* Monitors administrative responsibilities to meet deadlines set by group management (e.g., expense reports, new business reports, quarterly narratives, monthly schedules, and/ or forecasts, etc.).


Position Requirements


* Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field of study preferred (e.g., Business, Marketing, etc.)
* Five (5\) years' experience in Automotive, Fleet and/or Law Enforcement sales required.
* In lieu of sales experience, ten (10\) years experience working in the Automotive, Fleet and/or Law Enforcement industry.
* Willingness to travel extensively.
* Working knowledge of word processing, database and spreadsheet plus strong customer issue trouble\-shooting capabilities using multiple channels
* Excellent communication skills, capable of effectively communicating information, both verbally and in written word to diverse audiences


**WAGE:** Base salary of $75,000\- $85,000, with opportunity to earn a significant amount above base pay through participation in a company run Sales Incentive Plan. Additional perks include a cell phone, computer, use of company vehicle and approved travel expenses.

**Position Summary**

ICER Brands is seeking a creative and detail\-oriented Fashion Designer who can develop tech packs for overseas production to join our Design team. The ideal candidate has experience in licensed apparel and wholesale product development, with the ability to create accurate technical packages for overseas manufacturing partners. The Designer most also have knowledge in sizing and placing graphics on garments for production purposes.

The Designer will collaborate closely with Design, Product Development, Production, and overseas factories to ensure products meet customer expectations, licensing requirements, and production standards.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Tech Pack / Art Development**

* Create detailed production\-ready Tech Packs for all assigned styles.
* Prepare accurate garment flats using Adobe Illustrator.
* Develop and maintain:
* Construction details
* Understand measurement specifications (Cut \& Sew)
* Sewing instructions
* Artwork placement
* Trim and label placement
* Packaging requirements
* Wash and finishing details
* Ensure all technical packages are complete and ready for factory development.
* Update technical packages throughout the sampling process.
* Keen eye for sizing graphics to be placed properly on all garment silhouettes.
* Help ensure all products comply with licensor guidelines and brand standards.

**Licensing \& Brand Compliance**

* Ensure all products comply with licensor guidelines and brand standards.
* Incorporate required revisions from licensors into final production packages.
* Maintain consistency across all licensed programs.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Spec Department and Production to resolve and update technical and manufacturing challenges.
* Work closely with Licensing, Graphics, Merchandising, and Sourcing teams throughout development.
* Communicate daily with overseas factories regarding sample development, construction, and production questions.
* Communicate and provide revisions and technical corrections to overseas factories.
* Support customer meetings by preparing product presentations and development updates.
* Review prototype, fit, salesman, and production samples.

**Production Support**

* Assist in resolving production issues while maintaining quality standards.
* Ensure all styles remain on schedule to meet customer delivery dates.
* Maintain organized style files and development records.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Fashion Design, Technical Design, or related field preferred.
* 3–7 years of apparel design and technical design experience.
* Experience within the wholesale apparel industry required.
* Licensed apparel experience strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of garment construction and manufacturing.
* Experience working with overseas factories.
* Ability to manage multiple brands, retailers, and seasonal calendars simultaneously.

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Job Title: Director, Data Analytics \& Automation


Reports To: VP, Data Analytics \& Automation


Department: Strategy, Integration and Operations


Location: Los Angeles


A little bit about our team:


The Warner Chappell Global Strategic Integration and Operations team is a small but mighty team focused on delivering and implementing business objectives. Working closely with our global leaders, we are responsible for driving and embedding our global business strategy.


The Data Analytics \& Automation team sits at the intersection of business strategy, data products, analytics, and operational automation. We partner across all core WCM business domains, regional teams, and global leadership to turn complex business questions into reliable reporting, scalable data models, workflow tools, and automation that improve decision\-making and reduce manual effort.


Your role:


As the Director, Data Analytics \& Automation, you are a senior player\-coach responsible for leading a high\-performing team across both data analytics and automation. You will help define and execute the roadmap for modern data products, workflow automation, AI\-enabled development, and self\-service analytics across Warner Chappell. This role requires strong business judgment, hands\-on technical fluency, people leadership, and the ability to translate ambiguous stakeholder needs into practical solutions that are scalable, governed, and adopted by the business.


You will lead analysts and automation specialists who build across dbt, Snowflake, Dagster, Streamlit, Airtable, AI\-assisted development tools, and related modern data and workflow technologies. You will be expected to shape priorities, mentor talent, raise technical standards, manage cross\-functional delivery, and ensure the team is building durable assets rather than one\-off outputs.


Here you’ll get to:

* Lead a multidisciplinary data and automation team: Manage, mentor, and develop analytics and automation talent, fostering a culture of business partnership, technical excellence, ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Own the strategic roadmap for analytics and automation: Partner with the VP, Data Analytics \& Automation and global stakeholders to define priorities across data products, workflow automation, platform modernization, AI\-assisted development, and self\-service reporting.
* Translate business ambiguity into practical solutions: Work with senior stakeholders across all core WCM business domains, regional teams, and global leadership to clarify problems, identify decision points, and shape the right analytical or automation approach.
* Drive delivery of durable data products: Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and adoption of reusable dbt models, governed Snowflake assets, scheduled Dagster jobs, Streamlit applications, Airtable workflows, dashboards, and recurring reporting products.
* Advance platform modernization: Help move the organization away from fragile legacy reporting, manual extracts, disconnected spreadsheets, and one\-off workflows toward maintainable data models, governed reporting layers, repeatable automation, and scalable product patterns.
* Establish standards and governance: Develop and reinforce best practices for data modeling, code review, documentation, access control, scheduling, quality checks, stakeholder handoff, AI\-assisted development, and production support.
* Lead high\-impact analytical initiatives: Guide work that supports business\-critical decisions, operational improvements, revenue opportunities, rights and repertoire strategy, financial visibility, and scalable reporting across WCM's core business.
* Champion automation and AI\-enabled workflows: Identify opportunities to use automation and modern AI tools to accelerate delivery, reduce manual operational burden, improve business processes, and help the team prototype responsibly without sacrificing reliability.
* Build strong cross\-functional relationships: Act as a trusted liaison between business teams, technology partners, data platform stakeholders, and regional leaders to ensure solutions align with business priorities and technical architecture.
* Communicate impact to leadership: Regularly report on roadmap progress, delivery health, adoption, risk, operational improvements, and measurable business impact for analytics and automation initiatives.
* Develop future leaders: Coach team members on stakeholder management, technical judgment, prioritization, delivery discipline, and how to turn repeat requests into scalable team assets.


About you:

* A strategic leader with technical depth: You have significant experience leading data, analytics, automation, business intelligence, or process improvement teams, with enough hands\-on technical fluency to guide architecture, review tradeoffs, and unblock delivery.
* A business\-first data product thinker: You understand that the goal is not just to ship reports or scripts, but to create trusted tools and data assets that improve decisions, reduce manual work, and scale with the organization.
* Experienced across modern analytics and automation tools: You have practical familiarity with modern data stacks such as Snowflake, dbt, orchestration tools like Dagster, Python\-based applications or automation, Streamlit or similar internal app frameworks, BI/reporting tools, Airtable or workflow platforms, and AI\-assisted development tools.
* Comfortable leading both analysts and automation specialists: You can support people working on analytical modeling, stakeholder reporting, data extraction, workflow automation, internal tools, and productionized data applications.
* Strong in stakeholder influence: You can communicate complex technical and analytical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, influence prioritization, and help senior leaders understand both business impact and implementation tradeoffs.
* Proven in complex delivery: You have managed projects from ambiguous request through design, development, testing, deployment, adoption, documentation, and support, with measurable business outcomes.
* A thoughtful people manager: You know how to coach, prioritize, delegate, review work, manage performance, create growth opportunities, and build trust across distributed teams.
* Focused on scalable standards: You naturally look for patterns, reusable components, governed data assets, and better team practices instead of allowing critical workflows to depend on tribal knowledge or manual heroics.
* Change\-management oriented: You have experience helping teams adopt new tools, new processes, and more modern ways of working while staying grounded in business realities.
* Analytical and pragmatic: You are comfortable working through imperfect data, legacy systems, regional nuance, operational constraints, and competing stakeholder priorities to make sound decisions.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Data Science, Analytics, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.


We’d love it if you also had:


We are seeking a senior leader who is passionate about using data, automation, and AI\-enabled development to make the business more effective. The ideal candidate is curious, practical, and comfortable operating across both strategy and execution. They can guide a team through technical decisions, build confidence with senior stakeholders, and help the organization move from manual operational dependency toward trusted, scalable data products and workflow automation.


This person should be energized by the music publishing business and by problems that span WCM's core business domains, regional operations, and global priorities. **FOOTWEAR DEVELOPER**

**What will you do?**


A day in the life of a Footwear Developer at Altra looks a little like this.


The Footwear Developer will be responsible for driving the development, engineering, fit, margin adherence and specifications for new and existing Footwear from Final Design Review to Commercialization with a focus on Project based management. Drive footwear product development from seasonal kickoff to confirmation for production.


You will be responsible for collaborating with and supporting overall footwear cross\-functional teams to create best in class performance footwear. You will do this by focusing on footwear best practices/standards, fit and comfort, providing technical solutions, building product at cost and ensuring product quality.


Let’s break down that day\-in\-the\-life a bit more.

* Manage the development of products from kickoff to production ensuring triad adherence to the product creation calendar milestones through pro\-active follow ups.
* Initiate and lead meetings with product teams during various phases of development to review, evaluate, update and ultimately drive the decision\-making process that leads to on time Buy Ready and achieves margin goals.
* Confirm final development samples on time and ensure samples meet expected quality and accuracy standards. Manage retention and storage of samples in coordination with the Commercialization Manager.
* Work with VF Asia Development and factory Costing, Development, Engineering and Manufacturing teams to identify and leverage potential manufacturing efficiencies to drive reduced product cost.
* Evaluation and review of tooling including but not limited to reading 2D blueprints, reviewing 3D CADs and printing 3D components for physical review prior to approval to opening sample molds.

PATH is seeking candidates with experience in culinary services and current managerial food handler's certificates to join our Orange County Team as the Head Chef for our Yale Navigation Center.


**ABOUT OUR CULINARY SERVICES**  

Our Culinary Services Team is a critical to the success of our interim housing sites. By providing three meals and snacks and refreshments throughout the day, the kitchen and its staff are a key component to creating a welcoming, home\-like environment for our guests as they work to obtain and sustain permanent housing.


**WHAT IS A HEAD CHEF?**  

As part of the Interim Housing team, the Head Chef is responsible for providing administrative, supervisory, and quality control oversight to the kitchen staff and coordination of guests' dietary menu plans as needed.



Responsibilities include:


* **Staff Supervision \& Support**
	+ Provide direct supervision to all culinary staff, including Kitchen Associates, Lead Cooks, and Sous Chefs. Coordinate scheduling of all kitchen staff, including volunteers.
	+ Plan, set, and adjust as needed ongoing workload assignments and schedules for work completion. Ensure adherence to work and time schedules.
	+ Provide all necessary supports to volunteers to ensure they have a valuable experience.
* **Leadership \& Client Services**
	+ Promoting and following the established interim housing values, guidelines, and rules.
	+ Modeling and promoting a team culture and environment that is professional and welcoming for all interim housing guests, staff, volunteers, and other visitors
	+ Meeting with guests with medical dietary restrictions to set up menu plans
* **Kitchen Administration \& Oversight**
	+ Helping create and post monthly menus
	+ Assisting with the monitoring kitchen costs including labor, food, supplies, and equipment
	+ Helping to ensure inventories are maintained
	+ Reviewing Health Department reports along with Head Chef and Sous Chef and assisting with correcting violations
	+ Coordinating and maintaining relationships with kitchen vendors and donors
	+ Coordinating food donations, including assisting with pick\-ups and drop\-offs as necessary
* **Kitchen \& Equipment Maintenance**
	+ Ensuring the kitchen is maintained to Health Department code and PATH standards.
	+ Setting the standards for maintaining kitchen sanitation and cleanliness
	+ Ensuring equipment is maintained equipment in proper sanitary and operating condition
	+ Coordinating regular maintenance activities such as hood exhaust cleanings, oil waste pick\-ups, and propane gas fills.
	+ Coordinating with PATH's facilities team for repairs, fixes, or other maintenance.
* **Food Preparation**
	+ Working with the Head Chef and Sous Chef to ensure that all meals prepared following Health Department code and served at the appropriate times and temperatures
	+ Assisting with daily taste tests to ensure all meals are palatable, appetizing in appearance, and meet PATH's standards

**WHAT YOU BRING**  

We're looking for candidates that:


* **Maintain and execute confidential information according to HIPAA standards**
* **Possess a high level of tolerance and understanding for individuals with urgent and multiple case management and health needs**
* Work just as well independently as they do on a team
* Exercise mature judgement, and are highly motivated, self\-starting and proactive
* Are excellent at communicating, whether in writing or verbally
* Are well organized, have a strong sense of prioritization, and can coordinate multiple demands in a high\-pressure environment
* Demonstrate proficiency with Microsoft Office Software, particularly Word and Excel.
* Possess strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to develop successful and positive relationships with individuals at all organization levels.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* **Seven (7\) years of relevant experience in the culinary field, three (3\) years leading a team in a culinary capacity.**


**MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Five (5\) years of relevant experience in the culinary field, one (1\) year leading a team in a culinary capacity.**
* **Current Managerial Food Handling certificate.**


**MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS**  

Regardless of qualifications, candidates must:


* Have employment eligibility verification
* Have or be able and willing to obtain CPR/First Aid training
* Successfully complete the following as a condition of hire:
	+ Tuberculosis Test
	+ Background Screening
	+ Drug Test

**DRIVING**  

Driving is an **essential function** of this position. To meet the employment requirements for this role, all candidates must:


* Have reliable transportation
* A valid driver's license
* Proof of insurance and ownership for personal vehicles used during work duties
* The ability to qualify for PATH's insurance coverage


**EMPLOYMENT ELIGIBILITY**  

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa.



PATH is committed to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and objectivity in our services and employment practices. To avoid potential conflicts of interest and ensure the integrity of our programs, we are unable to employ individuals who are currently receiving services from PATH or have received services within the past two years.

If this position sounds like a fit, please submit your application today. **A resume is required.**

Currently offering a $10,000 SIGN\-ON BONUS! $5000 paid after successful completion of 45 days and $5000 paid after 6 months of employment. Must be active employee to be eligible.\*

Paid training: training pay $27\.50/hr.

**JOB SUMMARY**


Contribute to the success of the organization and sales distribution site by effectively using sales techniques and processes to convert prospective owners into purchasers as well as reload Owners. Develop relationships with prospective owners by soliciting and following up on referrals and leads. Cater the sales experience to the individual needs and preferences of each potential owner, and follow through with the sales contract process to ensure that all required paperwork and legally required documents are completed accurately and in a timely manner efficiently. Maintain the customer relationship after the sale is complete to ensure continued owner satisfaction with the organization and to develop future business opportunities (i.e., reloads, referrals, additional sales).

 **CANDIDATE PROFILE**


Education and Experience


Required:

* High school diploma or GED
* Proficiency in English
* Incumbent is required to maintain an active and in\-good standing professional Real Estate License where mandated by law

  

Preferred:

* One\-year related experience

  

Successful Candidates Will Be Willing To:

* Must be willing to work weekends and holidays as required by business needs

 **JOB SPECIFIC TASKS**

 **Building and Maintaining Customer Base**

* Answer owner questions regarding use of properties and location amenities; make recommendations given the background information obtained on the owner through discovery.
* Follow up on referrals/leads from owners.
* Fulfill requests from owners or prospects regarding pricing, property maps, property descriptions, room locations, and portfolio/network information.
* Contact owners to monitor satisfaction, make aware of upcoming promotions, and develop business opportunities (e.g., reloads, referrals).
* Develop and maintain records on customer contacts and use that information to support effective follow\-up opportunities.
* Monitor contract processing to minimize rescission decisions, provide comprehensive owner assurance and ensure timeliness of closings.

 **Giving Sales Presentations**

* Follow and adhere to the Consultative Sales Process when presenting to owners and guests.
* Establish trust with the prospective owner and Owners throughout the entire sales process to build on\-going rapport.
* Discover the needs of prospective owners and Owners through a series of strategically layered questions/discussion and utilize the information to customize the sales presentation.
* Provide prospective owners and Owners a Sales Gallery, Property and Model tour specific to their sales distribution site.
* Explain the features, advantages and benefits of the product and advocate the appropriate amount of points to accommodate the prospective owners and Owners current and future vacation needs.
* Complete and close the sales contract process by ensuring all required/legal paperwork and documents are signed and notarized.
* Practice and continue to develop and improve sales script and presentation.
* Ensure clear understanding of finance options and present as an approach to ownership.
* Prepare for daily appointments (e.g., review tour sheet, owner history, presentation details, etc).
* Follow up face\-to\-face guest interaction with email, phone, or mail correspondence and facilitates use of Vacation Ownership Advisor.
* Answer Owner and customer questions regarding product information, servicing issues, construction work, financing, maintenance, repairs, and appraisals.
* Use, demonstrate, and/or coordinate virtual tour (eTour) software for guests.

 **Conducting and Managing Business Transactions**

* Assure complete and accurate processing of documents pertaining to sales.
* Review details of contracts with prospective owners and Owners once they decide on purchase.
* Thoroughly review loan applications and financial documents with the customer and ensure completed properly.
* Work with Sales Management to minimize cancellations, provide comprehensive owner assurance and ensure timeliness of closings.
* Analyze problems and formulate a strategy and plan to overcome challenges of getting work done quickly with a high degree of quality.
* Complete purchase summary worksheet at end of each sale.
* Reach out to and influence Legacy Owners and Every Other Year (EOY) Owners to enroll, upgrade and maximize all reload opportunities.

 **Providing Service to Others**

* Respond to and monitor the resolution of customer and Owner inquiries in a timely manner with accurate information.
* Leverage resources for providing service to guests and Owners (e.g., Vacation Ownership Advisors) in an effective manner.

**Other**

* Manage time effectively to punctually attend daily team meetings, training sessions, and guest/owner appointments.
* Demonstrate total understanding of the culture and processes of the organization.
* Improve sales presentation approach through self\-critique, practice, and lessons from the feedback provided by others (e.g., Sales Manager Coaches, Guests, Owners).
* Participate in formal training sessions offered by management team.
* Attend daily huddles and regularly scheduled team/manager meetings.
* Assist in the development and mentoring of other Sales/Membership Executives as requested.
* Maintain an awareness of current events (e.g., news, sports, pop\-culture) and information on site locations to enable and promote customer relationship building.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Understand and abide by state and federal regulation around all sales and/or marketing activity (i.e. Do Not Call Lists, State registrations, Exemptions, etc).

 **COMPETENCIES, BASIC SKILLS, and PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS**

**Leadership**

* Adaptability \- Maintaining performance level under pressure or when experiencing changes or challenges in the workplace.
* Communication \- Conveying information and ideas to others in a convincing and engaging manner through a variety of methods.
* Professional Demeanor \- Exhibiting behavioral styles that convey confidence and command respect from others; making a good first impression and representing the organization in alignment with its values.
* Problem Solving and Decision Making \- Identifying and understanding issues, problems, and opportunities; obtaining and comparing information from different sources to draw conclusions, develop and evaluate alternatives and solutions, solve problems, and choose a course of action.

**Managing Execution**

* Driving for Results \- Planning and supporting the development of individuals' skills and abilities so that they can fulfill current or future job/role responsibilities more effectively.
* Planning and Organizing \- Gathering information and resources required to set a plan of action for self and/or others; prioritizing and arranging work requirements to accomplish goals and ensure work is completed.

 **Building Relationships**

* Coworker Relationships \- Interacting with others in a way that builds openness, trust, and confidence in the pursuit of organizational goals and lasting relationships.
* Customer Relationships \- Developing and sustaining relationships based on an understanding of customer needs and actions.

 **Learning and Applying Personal Expertise**

* Applied Learning \- Seeking out and making the most of learning opportunities to improve performance of self and/or others. Actively seeks and participates in learning activities; gains knowledge, understanding, and skill; applies knowledge or skill; welcomes performance feedback.
* Applied Business Knowledge \- Evaluating market dynamics, enterprise level objectives, and important aspects of the business to accurately diagnose strengths and weaknesses, anticipate opportunities and risks, identify issues, and develop strategies and plans. Aligning individual and team actions with strategies and plans to drive business results.

 **Basic Competencies**

* Job Specific Computer Skills \- Using computer hardware and software specific to job (e.g., MARSHA, PMS, SFA, NGS, Delphi, Point of Sale, HR technology).
* Mathematical Reasoning \- The ability to add, subtract, multiply, or divide quickly, correctly, and in a way that allows one to solve work\-related issues.
* Reading Comprehension \- Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents.
* Writing \- Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

 **Functional Job Family Competencies**

* Devising Sales Approaches and Solutions \- Trying different and novel ways to deal with sales challenges and opportunities; taking courses of action or developing sales solutions that appropriately consider available facts, constraints, competitive circumstances, and probable consequences.
* Sales Call Facilitation \- Ensuring that a call serves its sales objectives; maximizing the productiveness of interactions by monitoring and building on customers' cues.
* Sales Ability: Persuasiveness \- Using appropriate interpersonal styles and communication methods to gain acceptance of a product, service, or idea from prospects and clients.
* Sales Disposition \- Demonstrating the traits, inclinations, and outlooks that characterize successful salespersons; exhibiting behavior styles that facilitate adaptation to the demands of the sales role.
* Supporting Sales Implementations \- Supporting customers during the implementation of sales contracts; seeking and taking appropriate actions on customer feedback; taking responsibility for customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Sales Opportunity Analysis \- Understanding and utilizing economic, financial, industry, and organizational data; accurately diagnosing customers' business strengths, weaknesses, and key issues that can inform sales strategies and plans.

* Proficiency in professional design software such as Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat, Canva, or comparable platforms
* Ability to design multi\-page publications, including program books, brochures, or similar materials
* Experience creating content for social media, email marketing, print advertising, and digital campaigns
* Strong visual judgment and understanding of layout, typography, branding, and file preparation
* Excellent attention to detail, especially with dates, names, sponsor listings, concert information, and donor recognition
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at once
* Strong written communication skills
* Ability to work independently while taking direction and feedback well
* Reliable access to a computer, internet, and necessary design software
* Must be eligible to work in the United States

* Experience working with nonprofit organizations, arts organizations, orchestras, performing arts groups, or event\-based marketing
* Familiarity with email marketing platforms, social media scheduling tools, website content management systems, and basic web design principles
* Photography, video editing, or basic motion graphics experience
* Appreciation for classical music, live performance, community arts, or nonprofit mission\-driven work

Applicants must submit a **PDF portfolio or PDF work sample** with their application.

This is a part\-time position averaging approximately 20 hours per week. The schedule may vary depending on concert cycles, campaign deadlines, and special events.

Applications should demonstrate experience in graphic design, digital marketing, social media content creation, and production of polished print or digital materials.

**About EAB**


At EAB, our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data\-driven insights and best\-in\-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.



At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards.



For more information, visit our careers page.

  


**The Role in Brief:**


***Product Experience Designer (PXD), Analyst***



The Product Experience Designer (PXD) is a creative, technically minded member of EAB's Product organization responsible for transforming product strategy into compelling interactive experiences. Working at the intersection of Product Management, User Experience, and Go\-to\-Market teams, this role creates high\-fidelity prototypes, product demonstrations, and future\-state concepts that bring EAB's technology vision to life.



As a core member of the Product organization, the Product Experience Designer participates in product planning, design reviews, roadmap discussions, and development ceremonies to ensure commercial experiences accurately reflect current capabilities while showcasing the future direction of our products. This individual rapidly prototypes new ideas, designs narrative\-driven demonstrations, and creates reusable experiences that help customers, partners, and internal teams understand the value of EAB's technology.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys learning new technologies, experimenting with AI\-assisted design and prototyping tools, and translating complex product concepts into intuitive, engaging experiences. Success requires strong visual design instincts, attention to detail, curiosity, and the ability to collaborate across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Services, and Customer Success.



Reporting to Product Management and partnering closely with Product Design, this individual will leverage modern design and prototyping platforms—including Figma, AI\-assisted design tools, and emerging technologies—to accelerate product storytelling and strengthen EAB's commercial product experiences.



This position is ideally based in Richmond, VA or Washington, DC but is also open to remote employment within the continental United States.



This position is posted at both the Analyst and Senior Analyst levels; candidates are being considered across both levels based on experience, with final level determined at the time of offer.

  


**Primary Responsibilities:**


* Design high\-fidelity interactive prototypes that communicate current product capabilities, future concepts, and strategic product vision.
* Create narrative\-driven product demonstrations that illustrate how EAB technology solves real\-world challenges for higher education institutions.
* Participate as an embedded member of the Product organization by attending product planning sessions, roadmap reviews, design critiques, sprint reviews, and other product ceremonies.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Engineering teams to ensure prototypes and demonstrations accurately represent product functionality and design direction.
* Translate product requirements, concepts, and early\-stage ideas into compelling visual experiences that support discovery, planning, validation, and commercialization.
* Build and maintain reusable prototype assets utilizing EAB's design system, component libraries, and modern prototyping platforms.
* Explore and adopt emerging AI\-powered design and prototyping tools that improve the speed and quality of product visualization.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Partner Success, Implementation, and Customer Success teams to create product experiences that support launches, customer conversations, conferences, executive briefings, and strategic initiatives.
* Develop future\-state concepts that help leadership, customers, and internal teams visualize long\-term product strategy before engineering development begins.
* Continuously improve EAB's library of commercial product experiences, ensuring demonstrations remain aligned with evolving product capabilities and roadmap priorities.
* Participate in stretch projects and strategic initiatives that advance Product and Go\-to\-Market collaboration.

  


**Basic Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Product Design, User Experience, Human\-Computer Interaction, Information Architecture, Graphic Design, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 1–3\+ years of professional experience in UX design, product design, prototyping, product marketing, demonstration design, or related disciplines.
* Experience building interactive prototypes using Figma or comparable prototyping platforms.
* Strong visual design skills with exceptional attention to detail and an eye for polished user experiences.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies, software platforms, and AI\-assisted design tools.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with experience working across cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* A portfolio demonstrating interactive prototypes, product experiences, UX work, or similar design projects.

  


**Ideal Qualifications:**


* Experience working with product management and agile software development teams.
* Familiarity with modern product design systems and component\-based design methodologies.
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools such as Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies to accelerate design and prototyping workflows.
* Experience creating executive presentations, customer demonstrations, product storytelling assets, or conference experiences.
* Familiarity with higher education technology or SaaS products.
* Understanding of design thinking, human\-centered design, and product development methodologies.
* Ability to balance creativity with technical accuracy when representing software products.
* Demonstrated curiosity, experimentation, and a passion for continuously improving design workflows and emerging technologies.
* Commitment to embracing a continual learning environment and contributing to a dynamic and welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB's mission, values, and aspirations.


*If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.*

  


**Compensation:**



The anticipated starting salary (base) range for this role is $58,000 \- $75,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.



This hire will additionally be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, such as individual and organizational performance.

  


**Benefits:**



Consistent with our belief that our employees are our most valuable resource, EAB offers a competitive and inclusive benefits package. Our benefits currently include:


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible
* 20\+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays
* Daytime leave policy for community service and flextime for fitness activities (up to 10 hours per month each)
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution
* Health savings account, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending account, and pre\-tax commuter plans
* Employee assistance program with counseling services and resources available to all employees and immediate family
* Wellness programs including gym discounts, incentives to promote healthy living, and family access to the leading app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation
* Fertility treatment coverage and adoption or surrogacy assistance
* Paid parental leave with phase back to work program for birthing and non\-birthing parents
* Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel
* Discounted pet health insurance coverage for dog and cat family members
* Company\-provided life, AD\&D, and disability insurance
* Financial wellness resources and membership in a robust employee discount program
* Access to employee resource groups, merit\-based advancement, and dynamic professional growth opportunities


Benefits kick in day one; learn more at eab.com/careers/benefits.


*This opening is not eligible for visa sponsorship at this time; EAB will thus consider candidates who possess U.S. work authorization that does not require employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.*

Posted Social is seeking a talented Web Designer to join our in\-office team in St. Louis. This role is built for a designer whose primary strength is web design — designing clean, effective, visually strong websites — with the range to also step into general graphic design projects as needed.

This is a full\-time, in\-office position for someone who wants ownership over a specialized lane of work while still being a flexible, collaborative part of a fast\-moving creative team.

Applications submitted without a portfolio or work samples will not be considered.

**Responsibilities**

* Design websites for clients across a variety of industries
* Create layouts, visual systems, and UI design that translate clearly for development
* Support the design team with graphic design work as needed — social content, digital ads, print and physical marketing assets
* Translate strategy and messaging into clean, effective web and visual design
* Collaborate closely with internal developers to ensure designs are built accurately and effectively
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and deadlines
* Collaborate closely with the design team, social media team members, and company leadership
* Maintain consistency and quality across all client deliverables
* Stay current on web design trends and best practices

As a core member of the Product organization, the Product Experience Designer participates in product planning, design reviews, roadmap discussions, and development ceremonies to ensure commercial experiences accurately reflect current capabilities while showcasing the future direction of our products. This individual rapidly prototypes new ideas, designs narrative\-driven demonstrations, and creates reusable experiences that help customers, partners, and internal teams understand the value of EAB's technology.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys learning new technologies, experimenting with AI\-assisted design and prototyping tools, and translating complex product concepts into intuitive, engaging experiences. Success requires strong visual design instincts, attention to detail, curiosity, and the ability to collaborate across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, Services, and Customer Success.



Reporting to Product Management and partnering closely with Product Design, this individual will leverage modern design and prototyping platforms—including Figma, AI\-assisted design tools, and emerging technologies—to accelerate product storytelling and strengthen EAB's commercial product experiences.



This position is ideally based in Richmond, VA or Washington, DC but is also open to remote employment within the continental United States.

description:
7AI is building the Operating System for the SOC — an Agentic Security Platform where AI agents investigate and triage security alerts, so security teams get their time back for the work that needs a person. We're growing our in\-house design team and looking for a Senior Visual Designer to join our team of designers and lead the visual side of the product.


Our team is strong on UX — we know how the product should work. This role is about how it looks, feels, and communicates: typography, color, layout, iconography, data visualization, and the visual system that ties it all together. You'll own that layer and raise the bar on craft across the team.

**What You'll Do (Carolyn Rev)**
--------------------------------

* Own and evolve the visual language of 7AI's Agentic Security Platform with an eye for clean, legible interfaces on technical, data\-heavy surfaces
* Think in systems: collaborate with the team to develop high fidelity patterns that act as building blocks across our platform, from dashboards to data\-dense workflows.
* Turn UX flows and low\-fidelity concepts into polished, production\-ready, and reusable components, and produce the assets and specs that support pixel\-perfect implementation.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to build interfaces with real visual fidelity
* Drive rigor and consistency across our design system — auditing, documenting, and pushing the team's contributions toward one visual standard
* Raise the bar on craft and attention to detail across the design team, and give feedback that helps the rest of the team grow their visual skills

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 6\+ years of experience in visual design, UI design, or product design with a strong visual focus
* A portfolio that shows real depth in typography, layout, color, hierarchy, and data visualization — not just interaction design
* Experience designing for complex, data\-rich products
* Experience building or leading contributions to a design system, with a visual focus
* High proficiency in Figma
* A sharp eye for detail — spacing, alignment, and polish matter to you
* Comfort giving direction and feedback to other designers on visual craft
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership startup environment

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience designing for security, infrastructure, or other technical B2B products
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted design tooling as part of your regular workflow

Description:  



The Pre\-Press Graphic Designer provides critical support to the sales and production teams by preparing accurate, press\-ready files for print and ensuring artwork meets production specifications and client expectations. This role is responsible for reviewing customer\-supplied files, making necessary adjustments for print compatibility, and generating proofs for approval. The ideal candidate has strong computer skills, a solid command of Adobe Creative Suite (particularly Illustrator and Acrobat), and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. A keen eye for detail, print production knowledge, and excellent file organization are essential.

**Essential Functions and Duties**

* Prepare and finalize artwork for wide\-format printing, packaging, and signage applications
* Review customer\-supplied files and correct issues related to color, resolution, bleed, and layout
* Preflight and package print files for internal production or outsourced vendors
* Cross\-reference artwork with job specs and purchase orders to ensure accuracy
* Create digital proofs for internal approval and client sign\-off
* Communicate file status, proof approvals, and production concerns with the sales and coordination teams
* Update the production job board with artwork completion and release timelines
* Ensure files are set up correctly for various production equipment (e.g., flatbed printers, cutters, routers)
* Maintain organized file systems and follow version control best practices
* Perform additional design or production tasks as assigned


Requirements:  



* 2 years of print experience
* Minimum of bachelor’s degree in design or related field
* Proficient in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop; competent in Microsoft Office products
* Always strive to adhere to Duncan\-Parnell’s Mission Statement

**Competencies**

* Strong work ethic
* Meticulous attention to detail \& accuracy
* Self\-Motivation \- Must be able to work independently
* Team Player

  



**Compensation and Benefits Include:**

* Competitive Salary
* Medical, dental, vision, accident, life, \& long\-term disability insurance available
* Medical and dependent care FSA or HSA
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid parental leave
* PTO \& Holidays

The Graphic Designer will work within the established Flat Branch Home Loans brand to create, update, and maintain a wide variety of print and digital marketing materials, including but not limited to fliers, infographics, post cards, brochures, print ads, yard signs, logos, business cards, promotional items, banners, booklets, and social media graphics.


This is a hybrid position. Candidates within driving distance of the Chesterfield office will be considered.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design print and digital marketing materials that consistently reflect established Flat Branch Home Loans brand standards.
* Effectively manage a diverse workload of print and digital design projects, balancing priorities and consistently meeting deadlines
* Develop thoughtful design solutions that balance creativity, brand standards, and client needs.
* Review and proofread marketing materials for accuracy, consistency, and adherence to brand standards and compliance guidelines before final delivery.
* Work directly with Loan Officers and other internal clients to understand project goals, communicate expectations, and build positive working relationships across the organization
* Maintain open communication throughout the entire process with marketing team members and leads
* Continuously improve technical and design skills while staying informed on best practices and design trends
* Demonstrate a willingness to learn and use emerging technologies, including AI\-powered creative tools, to improve efficiency and support the development of marketing materials.
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment by supporting department initiatives and assisting teammates as needed


Requirements:

* Portfolio demonstrating strong design fundamentals
* Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Acrobat), Microsoft Office (Word and PowerPoint), and Canva
* Independent work style yet comfortable collaborating with others
* Ability to follow established processes and brand guidelines
* Strong organizational, time management, and creative problem\-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail
* Enjoys working on a diversity of tasks and projects.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Takes ownership of assigned projects and consistently produces high\-quality work.
* Handles constructive criticism from clients and team; Provides thoughtful
* feedback to others.
* Demonstrates conceptual thoughtfulness and supportive communication in design.
* Strong, professional communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively to a broad range of employee segments across the company
* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
